header.title: Attribution audit
header.business: A US criminal and traffic defense law firm
header.health_math: 0 fail, 2 warn, 1 unknown: no fail in areas 1-2 and two warns, so NEEDS WORK

scorecard.key_number: auto-tagging on; enhanced conversions for leads on
scorecard.why: Google Ads has auto-tagging on, enhanced conversions for leads on and the customer data terms accepted. GA4 and other ad platforms are not connected for this business, so their tags were not checked (see Unknowns).

scorecard.key_number: 5 counted actions; 1 lead action counts every conversion per click (1.2% of counted)
scorecard.why: 'Phone Call (imported)' counts MANY_PER_CLICK on a lead. It is under 10% of counted conversions, so warn, not fail. It can also record the same caller as 'Call or Text' (a tap on the site's phone link); the overlap is at most 7 conversions, 1.2% of counted.

scorecard.key_number: click windows of 30 and 90 days on counted actions; 100% of counted conversions arrive within 30 days
scorecard.why: 92% of counted conversions came the same day as the click. The slowest counted action reached 95% by day 21, so the target window is 30 days. Call or Text and Phone Call (imported) use a 90-day click window and recorded nothing after day 30: the extra days can only let late touches claim credit (over-attribution). The 30-day actions put at most 2% in their last bucket (21-30 days), under the 5% that would suggest the window cuts conversions off. Counted actions also use both 30 and 90 days, so they are credited on different rules.

scorecard.key_number: 5 of 5 counted actions on data-driven, model available
scorecard.why: Every counted action uses data-driven attribution with the model available. The last-click actions are secondary Google-hosted local actions that bidding doesn't use.
All campaigns are Search, so no conversion is credited to an ad that was only seen. The 30-day view window on 'Calls from ads' has nothing to act on.

scorecard.key_number: 1 platform connected; no backend count given
scorecard.why: Only Google Ads is connected for this business and no CRM or intake count was given, so the over-count against the real number of leads and the GA4 first-touch versus last-touch view could not be measured.

what_google_ads_claims.reading: Bidding and the Conversions column use 574.5. 'All conversions' is 1056.5 because it adds 482 secondary actions, mostly Google-hosted local actions such as profile engagements, which nobody should read as leads.

time_to_convert.caveat: Lag is measured on clicks in the 90-day period, so a 30-90 day lag could only show for the earliest clicks. None did.

ga4_view.why: GA4 is not connected for this business, so the three attribution views (property model, last non-direct session, first user) were not pulled.

over_count.why: Only one ad platform is connected, so there is no sum of platforms, and no backend count was given. Give the intake count of new leads for the same 90 days to see how far Google Ads' claim is from it.

overlap_inside_google_ads.reading: A tap on the site's phone number fires 'Call or Text'; the imported 'Phone Call' is uploaded later for calls tied to an ad click. One person can trigger both. The import is small, so at worst it adds about 1% to the count, but it counts every conversion per click and runs on a 90-day window.

bidding_exposure.reading: Most counted conversions sit in campaigns on Maximize Conversions, so whatever the counted set includes is what bidding chases. That is why counting and overlap matter more here than in reporting.

source_of_truth.source: The firm's intake or CRM count of new leads and signed cases
source_of_truth.use_for: how many leads really came in
comparing channels on one set of rules

model_recommendation.why: The model is available on every counted action and 92% of conversions happen the same day as the click, so most paths are one click long and data-driven and last click give nearly the same answer. Last click would only be the better choice if data-driven stopped being available.
model_recommendation.windows: 30-day click window on every counted action: the slowest counted actions (Contact us and Phone Call (imported)) reached 95% by day 21 (all counted conversions together by day 4), and 30 is the next of 7, 14, 30, 60 or 90 days. It matches the three actions already on 30 days and drops the 90-day windows that only over-credit late touches.
